review_evidence: README describes SATurn as a Lean 4 SAT solver-prover based on DPLL that returns either a solution or a resolution tree and whose termination/correctness is checked by Lean.

The retained modules define clauses, resolution, containment, DPLL, proof/solution structures, N-Queens and examples; executable nqueens.lean is conservatively retained as a user-facing application of the verified solver.
Complete lakefile.lean inspection found only package options, Mathlib/doc-gen dependencies and library/executable targets.

rules.content_invariant: The exact file is Lake package/dependency/target configuration and owns no SAT clause semantics, resolution proof, solver correctness interface or verified example.
